acf.s006_p: The Australia investment visa: business and investor routes to residence for your whole family
acf.s010_h2:
Australia paused new applications
to its investment visas in July 2024
acf.s011_p: Australia's Business Innovation and Investment (subclass 188) visas are not accepting new applications. IMM Group advises on the route that fits your family, based on where each program stands and on your own circumstances.
acf.s012_p: ! Why this page is still useful
acf.s013_p: What follows gives you an overview of the 188A, 188B and 188C streams, so you can compare them if the program reopens, or weigh the alternatives.
acf.s017_h2: What is the Australia investment visa?
acf.s018_li: A route for business owners and investors who want Australian residence through a business or an investment.
acf.s019_li: Your family can be included on the application and can live, study and work in Australia for the life of the visa.
acf.s020_li: The usual route: the temporary 188 visa, then permanent residence on the 888 visa, then Australian citizenship once you meet the conditions.
acf.s021_li: Each stream suits a different level of capital, management experience and migration goal.
acf.s026_p: A successful record in business management or investing
acf.s028_p: A$300,000 – A$5 million depending on the stream
acf.s033_p: Three main streams, each suited to a different goal, level of capital and investment model. The common route: the temporary 188 visa, then permanent residence on the 888 visa after at least 3 years, then Australian citizenship.

acf.s212_h2: From temporary residence to Australian citizenship
acf.s213_p: Four clear milestones for your family — from the 188 visa to Australian citizenship.
acf.s217_li: The whole family — the applicant, spouse and dependent children under 23 — moves to Australia to live, work and study for the 5-year life of the visa
acf.s218_li: Free public schooling for your children through high school
acf.s220_p: Hold the 188 visa for at least 3 years
acf.s221_h3: Carry out the investment or run the business
acf.s222_li: 188A: run the Australian business continuously for at least 2 years; turnover of at least A$300,000 over the most recent 12 months; at least 1 year of residence in the 3 years before you file the 888A
acf.s223_li: 188B: keep the A$2.5 million investment in place until the 888B is granted; at least 2 years of residence in total
acf.s224_li: 188C: keep the A$5 million investment in place; the main applicant spends at least 40 days a year in Australia, OR the accompanying spouse at least 180 days a year
acf.s228_li: Meet the investment or business conditions and the residence conditions, and the whole family applies for permanent residence — at the earliest after 3 years on the 188 visa
acf.s229_li: Full access to Medicare, education and social security on the same basis as Australian citizens, except the right to vote
acf.s230_li: The permanent residence card is renewed every 5 years
acf.s234_li: At least 4 years of lawful residence, with the most recent 12 months as a permanent resident on the 888 visa
acf.s235_li: No more than 12 months outside Australia across those 4 years, and no more than 90 days away in the final 12 months
acf.s236_li: With citizenship: full civic rights, plus visa-free access to 187 countries
